description: This file defines classes related to WFA map TLV for VbssConfigurationReport, including classes for report, radio info, and BSS info, with methods for parsing, creating, and managing these structures.

classes.name: VbssConfigurationReport
classes.description: Represents a Vbss configuration report with methods for parsing and managing radio list.

classes.name: cVbssRadioInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a radio within the Vbss configuration, including BSS list.

classes.name: cVbssBssInfo
classes.description: Contains BSS-specific information such as BSSID and SSID.

methods.name: VbssConfigurationReport
methods.description: Constructs the report object from buffer or base class.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: subtype
methods.description: Returns the subtype of the Vbss.

methods.name: radio_list
methods.description: Accesses radio info at specified index.

methods.name: create_radio_list
methods.description: Creates a new radio info object.

methods.name: add_radio_list
methods.description: Adds a radio info object to the list.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the object after parsing or creation.
